items.title:
ai.ravenroot:ravenroot-plugin-bundle 0.4.1-alpha.1 发布, Manifest schema, checksum, path-safety and reserved-namespace validation for
        drop-in plugin bundles (PLAT-12). A thin, zero-additional-dependency validator: it
        depends only on ravenroot-application-api, reusing PayloadJson/PayloadValue/PayloadLimits
        for manifest parsing rather than adding a YAML or JSON Schema library. Deliberately does
        not depend on ravenroot-core: this module never loads a class, never touches
        NodePackage/NodePackages, and is callable standalone by plugin.sh (build/validate/install)
        without pulling in the runtime.

ai.ravenroot:ravenroot-observability-otel 0.4.1-alpha.1 发布, PLAT-01: the OpenTelemetry export bridge, spans, metrics and
        log-correlation identifiers derived from ai.ravenroot.api.application.ExecutionEvent, the
        same event ai.ravenroot.server.audit.StructuredExecutionLogger already consumes. Depends on
        ravenroot-application-api (the event shape) and ravenroot-core (ExecutionMonitor.subscribe,
        the only extension point this module uses) and nothing else in the ai.ravenroot tree. Neither
        of those two modules, nor ravenroot-application-api's other consumers, every third-party
        node package, depends on this one: the OpenTelemetry SDK is reachable from exactly one kind
        of caller, a composition root (RavenrootServerMain, RavenrootCliMain), which is what makes
        "no OpenTelemetry dependency in core" a property the compiler enforces rather than prose.
        Disabled unless RAVENROOT_OTEL_ENABLED is set; see
        TelemetryConfiguration. Every OpenTelemetry artifact here is Apache License 2.0; this module
        has not been through the release SBOM and licence scan and should be before it
        ships in a tagged release.

items.content_text: ai.bithuman:essence2-android 0.5.9 发布, Android AAR for the bitHuman essence-2 avatar engine: drives an avatar bundle and composes teeth BORROWED from the donor bank rather than synthesizing them. A self-hosted session is metered at the published self-hosted rate (https://docs.bithuman.ai/guides/pricing); a credential the service rejects keeps rendering for a five-minute grace, then the session refuses, while a service that cannot be reached never stops a render. Bundles the engine's native library plus libonnxruntime.so and libc++_shared.so for arm64-v8a.
